Subject: Setting up Afiax Pharmacy needs a hand from Oortcloud

We're finishing Afiax Pharmacy for you

Hello Jane Wanjiku,

Setting up Afiax Pharmacy for Mama Pharmacy didn't finish on its own. Oortcloud's team has been told and is fixing it now. You don't need to do anything, and nothing you've entered is lost.

Everything else you have keeps working: your portal. In the portal, Afiax Pharmacy shows as "Needs Oortcloud" until it's ready.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We'll email you as soon as Afiax Pharmacy is ready, usually the same working day. If you need it urgently, reply to support and quote your organisation ID, mama-pharmacy.

QUESTIONS?

Email Oortcloud support at support@afiax.africa and quote mama-pharmacy.
